propositions: Pure intercepts like verify-commit-ticket dispatch before centralized ensure_initialized and can skip store mount entirely, causing 'ticket store not found' errors in fresh linked worktrees
Store mount logic is replicated per dispatch-arm with no guarantee all command paths execute it, creating a structural 'forgot to mount' bug
Mount half (init_only=True path through _create_tracker) must run at a single central CLI choke point before both intercepts and set-based dispatch for all store-touching commands
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted and must continue working with no store present
REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override must bypass the central mount gate without side effects to preserve test isolation and embedding scenarios
